subtitle.en: Scaling alpha to preserve the original alpha test coverage stops alpha-tested foliage from fading out with distance.
subtitle.zh: 缩放 alpha 以保持原本的 alpha 测试覆盖率，就能让用 alpha 测试做的植被不再随距离淡出。

translator.note: `mipmap` 按术语表不译；`coverage` 统一译「覆盖率」，`alpha test coverage` 译「alpha 测试覆盖率」；`alpha to coverage` 是硬件功能名，保留英文。归档里有两处「单独成行的反引号」（源文第 59 行与第 61 行，三层反引号围栏错位），属格式噪音，按已声明口径跳过。源文第 55 行与第 57 行的两个 C++ 方法声明各自独占一行、并且带行内链接，本来就不是围栏代码块，译文按原样保留为两个 `p` 块（`en` 逐字未动，`zh` 原样照抄，只补上源文在行尾漏掉的那个收尾反引号，使行内代码标记闭合）；带 `// Output first mipmap.` 注释的那段说明性代码才另立为 `lang: "cpp"` 的代码块。文中行内公式与变量名（`coverage`、`A_r`、`a_i`、`N`、`scale`、`a_r`）一律原样保留。

blocks.en: A little problem that we had when we started to create trees and vegetation is that the standard mipmap generation algorithms produced surprisingly bad results on alpha tested textures. As the trees moved farther away from the camera, the leafs faded out becoming almost transparent.
blocks.zh: 我们开始做树木和植被时遇到的一个小问题是：标准 mipmap 生成算法在 alpha 测试（alpha tested）的纹理上给出的结果差得惊人。树木离镜头越远，叶子就越是淡出，最后几乎变成全透明。

blocks.en: Here's an example. The following tree looked OK close to the camera:
blocks.zh: 举个例子。下面这棵树在离镜头近的时候看着还行：

blocks.en: ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2010/09/near_nocoverage-512x320.png)
blocks.zh: （原文此处有一张图）

blocks.en: but as we moved away, the leafs started to fade and thin out:
blocks.zh: 但随着我们离远，叶子开始淡出、变稀疏：

blocks.en: ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2010/09/mid_nocoverage-512x320.png)
blocks.zh: （原文此处有一张图）

blocks.en: until they almost disappeared:
blocks.zh: 到最后它们几乎不见了：

blocks.en: ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2010/09/far_nocoverage-512x320.png)
blocks.zh: （原文此处有一张图）

blocks.en: I had never encountered this problem before, neither had I heard much about it, but after a few google searches I found out that artists are often frustrated by it and usually work around the issue using [various](http://www.polycount.com/forum/showthread.php?t=65261) [hacks](http://www.gamedev.net/community/forums/topic.asp?topic_id=540726). These are some of the proposed solutions that are usually suggested:
blocks.zh: 我以前从没碰到过这个问题，也没怎么听说过，但搜了几下 Google 之后我发现，美术们经常被它搞得很烦，通常用[各种](http://www.polycount.com/forum/showthread.php?t=65261)[土办法](http://www.gamedev.net/community/forums/topic.asp?topic_id=540726)绕过去。下面这些是通常会被提出的解决方案：

items.en: Manually adjusting contrast and sharpening the alpha channel of each mipmap in Photoshop.
items.zh: 在 Photoshop 里手动调整每个 mipmap 的对比度，并把 alpha 通道锐化。

items.en: Scaling the alpha in the shader based on distance or on an lod factor estimated using texture gradients.
items.zh: 在着色器里按距离、或按用纹理梯度估算出的 lod 系数来缩放 alpha。

items.en: Limiting the number of mipmaps, so that the lowest ones aren't used by the game.
items.zh: 限制 mipmap 的层数，让游戏不去用最低的那几层。

blocks.en: These solutions may work around the problem in one way or another, but none of them is entirely correct and in some cases add a significant overhead.
blocks.zh: 这些方案也许能用某种方式绕开问题，但没有一个是完全正确的，有些还会带来可观的开销。

blocks.en: In order to address the problem it's important to understand why the geometry fades out in the distance. That is because when computing alpha mipmaps using the standard algorithms, each mipmap has a different alpha test coverage. That is, the proportion of pixels that pass the alpha test changes, in most cases going down and causing the texture to become more transparent.
blocks.zh: 要解决这个问题，先得弄明白几何体为什么会在远处淡出。原因是用标准算法计算 alpha 的 mipmap 时，每一层 mipmap 的 alpha 测试覆盖率都不一样。也就是说，能通过 alpha 测试的像素比例会变化，多数情况下是下降的，于是纹理就变得越来越透明。

blocks.en: A simple solution to the problem is to find a scale factor that preserves the original alpha test coverage as best as possible. We define the coverage of the first mipmap as follows:
blocks.zh: 一个简单的解决办法是找一个缩放系数，让它尽可能保持原本的 alpha 测试覆盖率。我们把第一层 mipmap 的覆盖率定义为：

blocks.en: `coverage = Sum(a_i > A_r) / N`
blocks.zh: `coverage = Sum(a_i > A_r) / N`

blocks.en: where `A_r` is the alpha test value used in your application, `a_i` are the alpha values of the mipmap, and `N` is the number of texels in the mipmap. Then, for the following mipmaps you want to find a scale factor that causes the resulting coverage to stay the same:
blocks.zh: 其中 `A_r` 是你的程序里使用的 alpha 测试值，`a_i` 是这个 mipmap 的各个 alpha 值，`N` 是这个 mipmap 里纹素的数量。接着，对后面的各层 mipmap，你要找一个缩放系数，让算出来的覆盖率保持不变：

blocks.en: `Sum(scale * a_i > A_r) / N == coverage`
blocks.zh: `Sum(scale * a_i > A_r) / N == coverage`

blocks.en: However, finding this `scale` directly is tricky because it's a discrete problem, in general, there's no exact solution, and the range of `scale` is unbounded. Instead, what you can do is to find a new alpha reference value `a_r` that produces the desired coverage:
blocks.zh: 不过，直接求出这个 `scale` 很麻烦，因为它是个离散问题，一般来说没有精确解，而且 `scale` 的取值范围是无界的。换个做法：去找一个新的 alpha 参考值 `a_r`，让它产生你想要的覆盖率：

blocks.en: `Sum(a_i > a_r) / N = coverage`
blocks.zh: `Sum(a_i > a_r) / N = coverage`

blocks.en: This is much easier to solve, because `a_r` is bounded between 0 and 1. So, it's possible to use a simple bisection search to find the best solution. Once you know `a_r` the scale is simply:
blocks.zh: 这就好解多了，因为 `a_r` 被限制在 0 和 1 之间。所以可以用一个简单的二分搜索找到最优解。一旦知道了 `a_r`，缩放系数就是：

blocks.en: `scale = A_r / a_r`
blocks.zh: `scale = A_r / a_r`

blocks.en: An implementation of this algorithm is publicly available in [NVTT](http://code.google.com/p/nvidia-texture-tools/). The relevant code can be found in the following methods of the FloatImage class:
blocks.zh: 这个算法有一份公开的实现，在 [NVTT](http://code.google.com/p/nvidia-texture-tools/) 里。相关代码可以在 FloatImage 类的下面几个方法里找到：

blocks.en: `float FloatImage::[alphaTestCoverage](http://code.google.com/p/nvidia-texture-tools/source/browse/trunk/src/nvimage/FloatImage.cpp#985)(float alphaRef, int alphaChannel) const;
blocks.zh: `float FloatImage::[alphaTestCoverage](http://code.google.com/p/nvidia-texture-tools/source/browse/trunk/src/nvimage/FloatImage.cpp#985)(float alphaRef, int alphaChannel) const;`

blocks.en: void FloatImage::[scaleAlphaToCoverage](http://code.google.com/p/nvidia-texture-tools/source/browse/trunk/src/nvimage/FloatImage.cpp#1002)(float desiredCoverage, float alphaRef, int alphaChannel);
blocks.zh: `void FloatImage::[scaleAlphaToCoverage](http://code.google.com/p/nvidia-texture-tools/source/browse/trunk/src/nvimage/FloatImage.cpp#1002)(float desiredCoverage, float alphaRef, int alphaChannel);`

blocks.zh: 从下面这张截图可以看到，这样就把问题彻底解决了：

blocks.en: ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2010/09/mid_coverage-512x320.png)
blocks.zh: （原文此处有一张图）

blocks.en: even when the trees are far away from the camera:
blocks.zh: 即使树木离镜头很远也一样：

blocks.en: ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2010/09/far_coverage-512x320.png)
blocks.zh: （原文此处有一张图）

blocks.en: Note that this problem does not only show up when using alpha testing, but also when using alpha to coverage (as in these screenshots) or alpha blending in general. In those cases you don't have a specific alpha reference value, but this algorithm still works fine if you choose a value that is close to 1, since essentially what you want is to preserve the percentage of texels that are nearly opaque.
blocks.zh: 注意，这个问题不只在用 alpha 测试时出现，用 alpha to coverage（就像这些截图里那样）或者一般意义上的 alpha 混合时也会出现。在那些情况下你并没有一个明确的 alpha 参考值，但只要你选一个接近 1 的值，这个算法照样能用，因为你本质上想要的是保持「接近不透明」的纹素所占的百分比。
